{{Top|leg}}
'''The Shimmersilk''' was a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] in [[the POTU]] district of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Considered rather undesirable, the Shimmersilk was cramped and affected by vibrations from a nearby [[Hovertrain/Legends|mag-lev train]] line. The restaurant's air quality was poor and it was cheaply-furnished.

In [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], a young [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was lured to the Shimmersilk under the guise of a meeting with a lobbyist from [[Silvestri Trace Power]], in fact part of an elaborate kidnapping attempt arranged by Senator [[Pax Teem]] as retribution against [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]].
